info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Careers Applications Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Status API provides a comprehensive overview of the current status of job applications submitted through the careers platform. This endpoint allows HR professionals and hiring managers to easily retrieve the latest updates on candidate applications, facilitating efficient tracking and decision-making during the recruitment process. Typical users include recruitment teams and business stakeholders looking to monitor application progress. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their hiring workflows and improve communication with candidates.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows clients to obtain the current status of all applications. It supports quick querying to check if an application is in progress, completed, or if there are any errors.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of applications. The data sent should conform to the specified schema and include necessary parameters to filter or determine the specific status of interest.
